quarterly_data.signal: Six months to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report, IFRS): net sales JPY 3,736,843 million (+7.7%); investment gain JPY 3,926,665 million (JPY 2,651,026 million a year earlier), including JPY 2,156.7 billion on the OpenAI investment (fair-value gains on the equity interest and on the forward contract for the second closing); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 2,924,066 million (+190.9%). Arm segment: record half-year net sales of USD 2,188 million (+22.7%) on customers' rising AI investment - royalty revenue USD 1,205 million (+22.9%, a record) as Armv9, with roughly twice Armv8's royalty per chip, replaced Armv8 in mobile and cloud and shipments of chips based on Arm's compute subsystems (CSS) rose; license and other revenue USD 983 million (+22.6%) from high-value, long-term license agreements with several major technology companies. SoftBank segment net sales JPY 3,400,459 million (+7.9%), segment income JPY 591,893 million (+9.6%). R&D expense for the half was JPY 383,241 million.
